hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler? We're in Coventry and aim to reach you within the hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Coventry
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle all plumbing and heating work in homes and small businesses throughout Coventry.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipe Repairs
services.desc: Leak detected at 2am? We're available round the clock. We locate the fault, stop the leak, and repair or replace the damaged pipe — often the same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: New condensing boiler fitted with a 10-year warranty. We handle all the paperwork, disconnect the old unit, and commission your new system with full safety checks.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your system running efficiently and cheaper to run. We power-flush radiators, bleed air, and service pumps to extend the life of your heating.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold spots in your radiators? We diagnose whether it's air, sludge, or a faulty valve, then fix it and balance your system for even warmth throughout the house.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Installing a new suite or relocating pipework? We handle all supply and waste connections, with minimal disruption and full building regulation compliance.

services.title: Frozen Pipe Thawing
services.desc: Frozen pipes cutting off your water supply? We safely thaw them with heat tracing and pressure testing, then insulate vulnerable sections to prevent it happening again.

about_pullquote: I started this business because my own boiler broke and the engineer charged me a fortune.
about_para_1: A. Lacey Plumbing & Heating has been serving Coventry homes and small businesses for 18 years. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local name, built on fair pricing and honest advice. We've completed over 2,500 jobs — from midnight emergency callouts to full heating system overhauls — and we treat every customer's home with the same care we'd give our own.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on three things: we arrive when we say we will, we explain what's wrong before we fix it, and we never overcharge. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals in Coventry, because people know we'll turn up, get the job done right, and leave you with a fair invoice.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Saturday evening in the kitchen. Called A. Lacey and they got to us in less than 45 minutes. Really professional, sorted it quickly, and the price was fair. Couldn't ask for better service. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark H.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in during the cold spell. Got through straightaway and they had a new one fitted within two days. The engineer explained everything, gave us a 10-year warranty, and showed us how to use the controls. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: Sandra B.

reviews.text: Called them out for a radiator that wouldn't heat up. They diagnosed a air lock, bled it, and balanced the whole system in an hour. No messing about, no unnecessary work. Fair price and friendly bloke. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.
